findings.title: Supply is concentrated
findings.detail: The top 10 owners control 56.5% of supply once linked wallets are merged (it looks like 50.6% if you count wallets naively).

findings.title: 6 hidden wallet clusters
findings.detail: 31 top-holder wallets resolve to 6 linked groups holding 20.1% of supply. The largest (3 wallets) holds 11.6%.

findings.title: Smart Money is holding
findings.detail: 20 Smart Money wallets hold 0.03% of supply.
